gloss: to associate with, to date, to keep company

definitions.explanation: To have a relationship or dealings with someone.

definitions.gloss: to date, to go out with
definitions.explanation: To be in a romantic relationship.

notes:
{付|つ}き{合|あ}う covers various types of relationships and social interactions.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

THREE MAIN MEANINGS:
1. To associate/socialize: {近所|きんじょ}の{人|ひと}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to socialize with neighbors)
2. To date: {彼|かれ}/{彼女|かのじょ}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to date him/her)
3. To accompany: {買|か}い{物|もの}に{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to accompany shopping)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜と{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to date/associate with ~
- 〜に{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to accompany someone to ~
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い: relationship, association (noun form)
- {長|なが}い{付|つ}き{合|あ}い: a long relationship

USEFUL EXPRESSIONS:
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}っている: are dating
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}める: to start dating
- {上手|うま}く{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to get along well with
